title: sutra_review: structural core
description:
## Parent

sutra/v1/5 — PRD: sutra v1 review intelligence engine

## What to build

Add `src/review.rs` — the review compositor. Accepts `diff` parameter (`branch` | `staged` | `unstaged`, default `branch` against main). Runs git diff, identifies changed files and symbols, computes impact via existing tools, calculates risk score (0.0–1.0) with breakdown (blast_radius, complexity_delta, hotspot_overlap, churn), truncates affected lists (top 20 with total count), ranks `recommended_reads` (top 10), includes freshness envelope. Register as `sutra_review` MCP tool.

This slice works without DD/FCA — structural analysis only. DD and FCA findings are wired in by the next slice.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `sutra_review` MCP tool registered and callable
- [ ] `diff="branch"` diffs current branch against main merge base
- [ ] `diff="staged"` and `diff="unstaged"` work correctly
- [ ] Response includes: changed_files, changed_symbols, affected_files (top 20), affected_symbols (top 20), affected_total, risk_score, risk_breakdown, recommended_reads (top 10), freshness
- [ ] Truncation: lists capped with truncated flag and true total count
- [ ] Risk score is 0.0–1.0 with per-signal breakdown
- [ ] Tests: fixture workspace with known diff, verify output shape and truncation behavior

## Blocked by

- sutra/v1/7 — Diagnostics module (freshness envelope)

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review (covers #13 + #14 together):

Verdict: needs-attention

4 findings:
1. [high] DD/FCA integration failures silently swallowed via unwrap_or_default() — empty violations indistinguishable from analyzer failure
2. [medium] FCA convention confidence not propagated to review output — violates distinct-confidence-semantics requirement
3. [medium] recommended_reads violation ranking uses HashSet — nondeterministic order, can drop higher-risk sites
4. [medium] Tests only exercise compute() with hand-built findings, never build_findings or handle — broken integration would still pass

Full review on #14."
